# THERMOTECH ENGINEERING
Manufacturer of industrial hot-water and steam boilers (5–25 MW).

## Primary Contact
- Email: info@thermotech-engineering.com
- Phone: +1 (555) 0142-555
- Address: 1200 Industrial Boulevard, Building 7, Moscow, 142000, Russia

## Products
- TH-500: Hot-water boiler, 5–8 MW, 0.6–1.6 MPa, 94.5% efficiency
- TH-1200: Steam boiler, 12–18 MW, 0.8–2.5 MPa, 92.8% efficiency
- TH-2500: Steam boiler, 20–25 MW, 1.0–3.2 MPa, 91.5% efficiency

## Certifications

- GOST R
- CE Marking (PED 2014/68/EU)
